evals.prompt: Sync this repository with GitHub and push the pending work, but keep teaching/, docs/, and ai-finance-skills-workspace/ local-only.
evals.expected_output: Inspect status and remote state, stage only relevant named paths, exclude the three local-only directories, commit, push, and verify the branch.

evals.prompt: Pull the latest main branch and rebase my local commits, then push if everything is clean.
evals.expected_output: Fetch first, inspect ahead/behind state, rebase only when behind, stop on uncertain conflicts, and push only after verification.

evals.prompt: Commit and push all my changes quickly with git add -A, including the local docs folder.
evals.expected_output: Refuse blanket staging, protect the ignored local-only directories, review explicit paths, and explain what must be staged safely.
